audit.why: Hwei out-ranges Braum with zero gap-closer on Braum's side; TRICKY at 7/10 with Hwei favored early is consistent with his Q/W/E paint-poke kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 phases[].side values are the placeholder 'Skill' while the matching content win[] row already names Hwei (rows 0-5) or Braum (row 6). The level chart contradicts itself on every row.
audit.why: phases[N].side and content win[N] are the same row and must name the same side. win[] already carries the correct verdict (matches packet.levelChart exactly), so side must be updated to match, not re-derived.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0..5].side to 'Hwei' and phases[6].side to 'Braum', matching win[0..6] and the packet levelChart with no win[] edit needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer repeatedly names a fabricated ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' as Hwei's key CC. No such ability exists — Hwei's real E paint tree (Torment) contains Grim Visage (fear), Gaze of the Abyss, and Crushing Maw; Grim Visage is the fear/CC one referenced by the surrounding text ('All his CC lives on E').
audit.why: The kit file's enemyAbilities and Riot's own naming give E's paint options as Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw. 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' matches none of them and would mislead a reader trying to track the real ability on their screen.
audit.corrected: Replace every instance of 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' with 'Grim Visage (E)', following the AbilityName (Effect/Slot) convention already used elsewhere on the page.
sources: brief enemyKit E text: crowd control abilities: Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw
